descriptions: Fixed female characters spawning as male with Config.SkinManager = 'esx_skin', because the chosen gender never reached skinchanger and esx_skin saved sex 0
Fixed existing characters logging in with the default skinchanger appearance on ESX with esx_skin, because their saved skin was never loaded before ESX.SpawnPlayer
Fixed the intro cutscene applying the previously viewed character's skin to a new character and saving its mugshot under that character
Fixed Escape on the date picker or nationality list cancelling character creation
Fixed overlapping fades and load scenes when going back or opening a new slot while the selection camera was still loading
Fixed the date picker ignoring the month names, weekday names and StartOfWeek from Config.Calendar
Added an optional storedSkin argument to Bridge.SpawnPlayer
